AspendoraFormAnalytics.FormsDocumentation: Per-form funnel from website events: how many visitors saw the form (50% visible), started typing, submitted, or left mid-form. Start rate = starts/views; conversion = submits/starts.
AspendoraFormAnalytics.FieldsDocumentation: Per-field interaction counts and average hesitation time (focus to blur). 'Last field before abandon' counts how often a field was the final one touched before the visitor left without submitting — high values point at the problem field.
